vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Hmm. That fits what I've been seeing. Let me think about the mechanism..."
👂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm "Hey — come here. You should hear this."

You catch fragments by the fire — Kebede telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A person, maybe 50s, with a nervous tic. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sidles up, rubbing their belly, eyes fixed on your pack. «お腹すいた。お願い…何か食べ物を。»
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
